title: MOSAIC: An Omni-Modal Benchmark for Long-Term Memory and Cross-Modal Reasoning in Conversational Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.29249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omni-modal assistants must remember not only what users say, but also what they show and convey. Existing long-term memory benchmarks are mostly text-and-image or report a single end-to-end score, so they cannot locate whether evidence is lost when it is represented, retrieved, delivered, or read. We introduce MOSAIC, a benchmark of 923 questions over persona-grounded histories of 11-24 sessions spanning text, image, video, and audio. MOSAIC constructs targeted spatial, temporal, and prosodic signals rather than decorative media, with the strongest causal validation for spatial information and selector-level validation for annotated prosody, and pairs them with a matched diagnostic protocol that freezes the question, reader, prompt, and budget while intervening on representation, retrieval, and delivery. translated_title: MOSAIC：面向对话智能体长期记忆与跨模态推理的全模态基准
translated_abstract: 全模态助手不仅需要记住用户说了什么，还要记住用户展示了什么、传达了什么。现有的长期记忆基准大多仅涉及文本与图像，或只报告单一的端到端分数，因此无法定位证据是在表示、检索、传递还是读取环节丢失的。我们提出了MOSAIC，这是一个包含923个问题的基准，问题基于跨越11至24个会话、涵盖文本、图像、视频和音频的角色化历史记录构建。MOSAIC构建的是具有针对性的空间、时间和韵律信号，而非装饰性的媒体，其中空间信息获得了最强的因果验证，标注的韵律获得了选择器级别的验证，并配以匹配的诊断协议——该协议在冻结问题、读取器、提示和预算的同时，对表示、检索和传递环节进行干预。匹配分解结果显示，表示损失依赖于具体模态，即使提供金标准证据，残余的读取损失仍占主导地位，且摘要内容在此处被截断。
tldr: MOSAIC是一个包含923个问题、覆盖文本、图像、视频和音频的全模态长期记忆基准，通过冻结读取环节、干预表示、检索和传递的匹配诊断协议，能够精确定位对话智能体在哪个环节丢失了跨模态证据。
en_tdlr: MOSAIC is an omni-modal long-term memory benchmark of 923 questions spanning text, image, video, and audio, whose matched diagnostic protocol—freezing the reader while intervening on representation, retrieval, and delivery—pinpoints exactly where conversational agents lose cross-modal evidence.
